notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.notes:
Up until now my characters (Jonas, Egis, Jurga and Rasa) were naked. Metahuman provided outfits were not believable for 90's look, so I created some outfits.

Using Marvelous Designer I designed clothes, Blender and Substance Painter for baking and texturing. 
Still need some work on weight painting, but it is getting there.

Next up... mocap animations.
